peServices.title: Tech, product & AI due diligence
peServices.body: What the platform is, whether the product earns the plan, and a costed AI value-creation plan in the IC pack.

peServices.title: Fractional AI operating partner
peServices.body: Retained by the fund: AI plans across the portfolio, a counterpart for each CEO, quarterly reporting to the IC.

peServices.title: Embedded AI delivery
peServices.body: Inside one portfolio company with its team: internal tooling, automation and agents in production in weeks.

peServices.title: Board & NED
peServices.body: A small number of seats where technology, product and AI decide the outcome.

aiPlan.title: Opportunity map
aiPlan.body: Every function walked — ops, finance, sales, service, product — and ranked by where AI moves cost or revenue most, with the evidence behind each call.

aiPlan.title: Cost-out and growth model
aiPlan.body: Hours, headcount and margin impact per opportunity, in a form your deal team can drop into the model — conservative, base and stretch cases.

aiPlan.title: Readiness
aiPlan.body: Whether the data, systems and people can support it today, and what has to change first. Most plans fail here, not on the technology.

aiPlan.title: AI claims, tested
aiPlan.body: If the target is selling an AI story: what's real, what's a wrapper, what's defensible, and what it costs to run at scale.

aiPlan.title: The first hundred days
aiPlan.body: A sequenced, costed delivery plan — quick wins in the first quarter, structural change after — ready for the incoming management team.

ddSteps.title: Scoping call
ddSteps.body: Deal context, access, timetable and which strands you need. Fixed quote the same week.

ddSteps.title: Fieldwork
ddSteps.body: Data room, code and systems review, and sessions with the CTO, product and operational leads.

ddSteps.title: Report and IC session
ddSteps.body: A red/amber/green findings report, the AI value-creation plan, and a walkthrough with the deal team or committee.

ddSteps.title: Post-completion, optional
ddSteps.body: Delivery of the plan alongside management, as a retained or embedded engagement.

opSteps.title: Portfolio baseline
opSteps.body: A short pass across every portco: where the hours go, what's already been tried, and who on each management team will carry it.

opSteps.title: Plans and priorities
opSteps.body: An AI value-creation plan per company and a portfolio view for the IC — what to do first, what to skip, and what it's worth.

opSteps.title: First deliveries
opSteps.body: Two or three quick wins in production across the portfolio, to prove the pattern and build management appetite.

opSteps.title: Steady state
opSteps.body: Monthly CEO sessions, quarterly IC reporting, embedded sprints where a portco needs hands, and diligence support on the pipeline.

steps.title: The call
steps.body: What's slow, what's expensive, what your team already tried. A straight answer on fit.

steps.title: Paid discovery, on site
steps.body: Days with the people doing the work. You leave with a ranked, costed list of what to build — whether or not we build it.

steps.title: Build, in the open
steps.body: Fixed price against the outcome. Your team in the room, shipping into your stack, demoed weekly.

steps.title: Handover, or stay close
steps.body: Documented and owned by your team. Some clients keep a light retainer or a board seat.
